column1: My own product: one wishlist link, and friends coordinate gifts privately so nobody buys the same thing twice. English and Persian, Telegram alerts. Designed, built and launched in one month.

Traditional wishlists fall short: friends accidentally buy the same gift, expensive gifts are hard to coordinate, reservations often reveal who bought what and ruin the surprise, sharing across messaging apps is cumbersome, and few solutions support multilingual users or modern messaging integrations. Giftbede was built as a privacy-first social experience to fix that.
column2: 传统愿望清单容易导致重复购买，昂贵的礼物也难以分摊。预订信息常常暴露送礼者，跨消息应用分享也不便，多语言和消息集成更不普及。Giftbede 以隐私为先，解决这些送礼协作问题。

column1: Giftbede is built around one idea: share one link and let everyone coordinate gifts privately. The platform includes personal wishlists, private and partial gift reservations, smart gift previews, Telegram notifications, private group chats for co-reservers, public profile sharing, social following, and English & Persian (RTL) support, all with privacy, usability, and mobile-first interactions in mind.
column2: Giftbede 的核心是用一个链接让大家私下协调送礼。平台提供个人清单、匿名及部分预订、智能礼物预览、Telegram 通知、共同预订者群聊、公开资料分享和关注功能，支持英语和从右至左排列的波斯语，优先考虑隐私、易用性与移动端。

column1: A single icon ecosystem: the Iconly Pro website, a Windows app, a Figma plugin and shared APIs, so designers find and use icons without leaving their tools. Built at Piqo Design.

column1: Designers and developers often struggle with fragmented icon libraries that lack consistency across platforms and design tools. Iconly Pro needed a scalable web platform for browsing and downloading icons, a desktop app for offline access, a Figma plugin in designers' workflows, a unified experience across every platform, and a maintainable architecture for continuous icon releases.
column2: 图标库分散在不同平台和工具中，体验往往不一致。Iconly Pro 需要一个可扩展的浏览下载网站、离线桌面应用和可融入工作流的 Figma 插件，还需要统一跨平台体验，并支持持续发布新图标。

column1: I built a unified ecosystem where designers could discover, preview, and use icons across multiple environments without disrupting their workflow: the Iconly Pro website, a Windows desktop application, a Figma plugin, reusable APIs shared across platforms, and optimised search and asset delivery.
column2: 我打通了 Iconly Pro 网站、Windows 应用和 Figma 插件，搭建跨平台复用的 API，并优化搜索及素材分发。设计师可以在各个环境中直接发现、预览和使用图标。

column1: Front-end for an email marketing product: the campaign dashboard, a drag-and-drop email designer and a visual automation flow builder.
column2: 我的调试优势是把画面问题拆成可独立验证的滤镜环节：用亮度校正器处理局部明暗，用 OBS 调色器统一肤色和色调，再用着色器特效滤镜处理素材边缘或定制效果。

column1: Marketing automation products need multiple complex interfaces that stay intuitive while handling large amounts of data and sophisticated workflows. Campaign Lark required a scalable campaign dashboard, a visual automation builder for customer journeys, a flexible yet approachable email designer, a modern marketing website for acquisition, and a maintainable frontend architecture for rapid feature development.
column2: 营销自动化平台需要处理大量数据和复杂流程，同时保持界面直观。Campaign Lark 需要可扩展的仪表盘、客户旅程编辑器、灵活易用的邮件设计器、面向获客的营销网站，以及便于快速交付功能的前端架构。

column1: I developed a modular frontend architecture so different parts of the platform could evolve independently while keeping a consistent UX. That included a responsive campaign dashboard, an interactive email editor, a node-based automation flow builder, the public marketing website, and a shared reusable UI component system across the product.
column2: 我采用模块化前端架构，让各部分可以单独演进并保持体验一致。成果包括响应式仪表盘、交互邮件编辑器、基于节点的流程编辑器、公开营销网站和共用组件库。

column1: Maileroo needed a modern, high-performance web platform that could convert visitors into customers while providing an intuitive dashboard for managing email infrastructure. column1: I developed a component-driven frontend using React and Next.js so marketing pages and the application dashboard shared a consistent design system. column2: 预算先花在镜头里看得出差别的地方。开工前核对表演区、走位、机位和已有设备，列清楚哪些要先解决，哪些可以等节目需要时再加。

column1: I developed a complete online 3D editor so users can customise their NFT characters entirely in the browser: wallet-based NFT importing, interactive rig controls, a facial expression editor, a professional lighting system, scene manipulation, high-resolution PNG export, and an optimised rendering pipeline for thousands of character variations.
column2: 搭建分三块：人物面光是基础，轮廓光和背景光按需要加，光束和灯光切换是选配。报价把复用、租赁、采购、运输和搭拆分开列。装好后，用你的相机和直播软件调曝光、白平衡与肤色，再按实际节目试播，留下常用灯位和预设。
